rounds.report:
L1 proxy reconstruction, CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (video50, 1280x720, 960 frames at 59.94 fps, 16.016 s).

Observed from the 24 reference samples: a single continuous over-the-shoulder shot with no cuts. A bald warrior stands in the left foreground with his back to the camera. He carries an axe on his back and holds a spear with a red cloth in his right hand. An archer at full draw stands ahead of him, slightly to image-right. A large pale big-cat beast with gold armor and a rider stands in the background-right in front of a stone gate with glowing wooden stakes. Red-leaved trees fill the top and a large green root-covered mass sits on the right. From about 4 s the beast prowls toward image-right and the camera yaws right (about 35 degrees) to follow it. The archer becomes hidden behind the warrior at about 5.5 s. From about 11 s the beast turns to face the camera and edges forward among red mushrooms. Near the end the camera pushes in and tilts down slightly.

Geometry: boxes, spheres, cylinders and cones for the warrior (torso, head, legs, cylinder-limb arms, axe handle and blade, spear, cloth), the archer (torso, skirt, hair, drawn arms, bow, string, arrow), the beast (body, chest, gold head, horns, saddle, spikes, four pivoting legs, tail) and the rider (torso, head, legs, arms). The environment is a ground plane, a plaza disk, a root ring, the gate, a wall, crates, a barrel, canopy spheres, trunk cylinders and mushroom cylinders.

Articulation: the beast's legs swing in a diagonal gait whose amplitude follows a walk-weight curve, and its tail sways. The warrior's right arm raises the spear between about 6.3 and 8.2 s. The rider's right arm gestures outward from about 13 s. The archer holds a static drawn pose and turns to track the beast.

Camera and timing: a third-person rig. Yaw, the warrior's screen bearing, distance and pitch are keyframed at every sample time from measured screen positions and interpolated with monotone cubics. The beast's path, its heading relative to the camera, and the archer's slow leftward drift are also keyframed at sample times. Everything is computed from absolute time.

Inference: motion between samples, depth and scale (estimated from a 40-degree vertical FOV), and the archer's state after she becomes occluded.

Feedback: none received yet (initial round).
